basic_info.description: Meticulously remodeled Presidio Heights treasure! Featuring 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, 2 offices, and a den/library across 3 levels. The home's spacious living room centers   a full view of the Golden Gate Bridge. Adjacent is a stylish dining room, with herringbone walnut floors, and a powder room revealing hand-painted wall coverings and a rose quartz sink. The heart of the home is the stunning kitchen, showcasing a striking panda marble island, deluxe appliances, and a built-in banquette, with an adjoining laundry room. Glass-enclosed stairs lead up to 2 east-facing bedrooms, a marble bath with shower over tub, and a library with chic blue lacquer built-ins. The sumptuous primary suite is well-appointed with 2 walk-in closets, a beautiful view of the Golden Gate Bridge, and a luxurious marble bath with a soaking tub, separate shower, and a double vanity. A private loft overhead reveals a peaceful office/sitting area. The 3rd level is flooded with light and houses a family room with built-in desk, a lovely bedroom, a marble bath with shower, and an office. Off the back stairs is a shared patio, offering a seating area, BBQ, and landscaping. Ideally located steps from the Presidio, and a few blocks to shops and dining on Sacramento St. Leased parking on Sacramento Street.
